name: Dwellings of Eldervale

categories.label: VP on score track
categories.hint: VP gained during play (dwellings built, combat, etc.).

categories.label: Elemental Power track markers
categories.hint: One entry per element marker: VP equals the number beside the marker.

categories.label: Dwellings
categories.hint: One entry per Dwelling: VP equals your track level for the element of its Realm.

categories.label: Adventure cards scored
categories.hint: One entry per scored Adventure card: VP equals your track level for its element (cap per Dwelling: see notes).

categories.label: Vault / Prophecy / other card text
categories.hint: VP awarded by Vault cards and fulfilled Prophecy cards per card text.

tiebreakers.description: Ties are broken by number of resources (per secondary source; verify in rulebook).

notes: family: area-control-engine-elemental-track. Game ends when the last Realm is drawn or a player builds a 6th Dwelling; every player (including the trigger) then takes one more turn. Official rulebook PDF could not be downloaded (BGG login wall, Scribd/boardgamesbot are viewers), so scoring comes from reviews/summaries. Unresolved: whether the Adventure card cap is 3 per player or 3 per Dwelling; faction-specific, Castle and Monster end-game scoring in the Appendix are not modelled; exact tiebreaker.
